Heraclius tells Abu Sufyan that apostles are tested by battles of alternating success, but the final victory is always theirs.
Sa'd is told victory and provision come only through the poor among them; armies are given victory while one among them has accompanied the Prophet, then his companions, then theirs.
The Prophet was given concise speech, victory through awe and the keys of the world's treasures; after Heraclius reads his letter, Abu Sufyan sees the Byzantine king fearing him.
Umar asks the Badr elders and Ibn Abbas about the sura on Allah's help and the conquest; Ibn Abbas says it signals the Prophet's approaching death, and Umar agrees.
A group of the Prophet's followers will remain victorious and keep to Allah's commands, unharmed by those who oppose them, until Allah's Order, the Hour, comes.
